params.body:
## Why

CI on `main` is red since #258: `ChatToggleTest > the chat endpoint is gone when the chatbot is off`
asserted a 404 on `POST /chatbot/message` and gets a 500. That test was mine, and it was testing the
wrong layer. `ChatBotController` resolves `ChatBotService` in its constructor, and that service needs
an OpenAI key no test environment has, so the constructor blows up before the `abort(404)` that the
test was aiming at. A request there says something about the key, not about the condition.

## What

The endpoint case is replaced by two that read the condition where its three callers read it
(`Access::showChat()` — the layout's include of the toggle, the Echo client, the abort in the
controller):

- `test_show_chat_follows_the_setting_for_a_beheerder_too` — the regression #258 fixed, stated
  directly: with the chatbot off the answer is false for a BEHEERDER as well, and with it on, true.
  A BEHEERDER used to be the exception that made this true whatever `CHATBOT_ENABLED` said.
- `test_a_guest_never_gets_the_chat` — the other half of the condition.

The two rendering tests from #258 (no toggle when off, a labelled toggle when on) are untouched, and
so is everything outside this file. Test-only change.

## Checked

`php -l` on the changed file. The database-backed suite cannot run on this machine — the local MySQL
only answers to a socket login this session does not have — so CI is the judge. In the #258 run every
other test passed, including all six of `WarrantyPasswordTest`; this one failure is the only thing
this PR addresses.
params.title: Settings: fix the red chat-toggle test from #258
